mapper.select: select p.permission_id, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status as user_status, coalesce(p.has_ai_seating, if(u.user_id = 1, '1', '0')) as has_ai_seating, coalesce(p.has_ai_config, if(u.user_id = 1, '1', '0')) as has_ai_config, coalesce(p.daily_limit, 50) as daily_limit, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from sys_user u left join seat_user_ai_permission p on p.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0'

select p.permission_id, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status as user_status, coalesce(p.has_ai_seating, if(u.user_id = 1, '1', '0')) as has_ai_seating, coalesce(p.has_ai_config, if(u.user_id = 1, '1', '0')) as has_ai_config, coalesce(p.daily_limit, 50) as daily_limit, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from sys_user u left join seat_user_ai_permission p on p.user_id = u.user_id
u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%')
and coalesce(p.has_ai_seating, if(u.user_id = 1, '1', '0')) = #{hasAiSeating}
order by u.user_id asc
